metadata.name: ResetVirtualCardLimit
metadata.description: This API is used to reset Virtual Card Limit.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:Atleast one of AdminNumber/CardNumber is required

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789632 Condition: Atleast one of AdminNumber/ CardNumber is required Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ResetLimitFlag
request_fields.description: Flag to reset card limit Valid Values: Send 1 in this flag if user want to update card's actual limit Example:1 Condition: ResetLimitFlag is mandatory if ResetTxnFlag is null or blank.

request_fields.name: CardLimit
request_fields.description: Card Limit of virtual card will set to this field value. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00 Condition : If ResetLimitFlag is true then CardLimit field is mandatory.

request_fields.name: ResetTxnFlag
request_fields.description: Flag to reset card's number of allowed transactions. Valid Values: Send 1 in this flag if user want to update card's number of allowed transactions. Example:true Condition:ResetTxnFlag is mandatory if ResetLimitFlag is null or blank.

request_fields.name: NumberAllowedTxn
request_fields.description: NumberAllowedTxn of virtual card will set to this field value. Condition:If ResetTxnFlag is true then  NumberAllowedTxn field is mandatory.

request_fields.name: VirtualCardLimitMethod
request_fields.description: Method on which Virtual Card limit is applied e.g. Account / Card. Valid Values: 0 = It means VirtualCardLimitMethod is Account (i.e Virtual Card uses Credit limit of Account) 1 = It means VirtualCardLimitMethod is Card (i.e Virtual Card uses Credit limit of its)

request_fields.name: ResetLimitFlag
request_fields.description: Flag to reset card limit. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: x Example: 1 Condition: ResetLimitFlag is mandatory if ResetTxnFlag is null or blank.

request_fields.name: CardLimit
request_fields.description: Card Limit of virtual card will set to this field value. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00 Condition : If ResetLimitFlag is true then CardLimit field is mandatory.

request_fields.name: ResetTxnFlag
request_fields.description: Flag to reset card's number of allowed transactions. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: x Example: 1 Condition: ResetTxnFlag is mandatory if ResetLimitFlag is null or blank."

request_fields.name: NumberAllowedTxn
request_fields.description: Number of transaction allowed on Virtual Card. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: x Example: 5 Condition:If ResetTxnFlag is true then NumberAllowedTxn field ismandatory.

request_fields.name: VirtualCardLimitMethod
request_fields.description: Method on which Virtual Card limit is applied e.g. Account / Card. Valid Values: 0 = It means VirtualCardLimitMethod is Account(i.e Virtual Card usesCredit limit of Account), 1 = It means VirtualCardLimitMethod is Card(i.e Virtual Card uses Creditlimit of its) Format: x Example: 1

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: VirtualCardResetAllow
request_fields.description: Flag to allow or not allow reset on Virtual card. Valid Values:0 = Yes, 1 = No Example:0 Condition: This field is mandatory when Secondary Card Type is '1'(Virtual).

request_fields.name: VirtualCardAutoReset
request_fields.description: Flag to decide if Virtual Card Limit will get auto-reset or not. Valid Values: 0 = Yes (Virtual Card Limit will be Auto-Reset) 1 = No(Virtual Card Limit will not be Auto-Reset) Format: X Example: 0,1 Condition: Allowed only if- 1. Virtual Card Limit has a value except 0 or NULL. 2. ‘Usage Reset Frequency’ is set to Billing Cycle at Product Level. 3. If no value is passed, then by default null will be considered as no auto-reset applicable.

response_fields.name: CardLimit
response_fields.description: Card Limit of virtual card will set to this field value. Valid Values: Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

response_fields.name: NumberAllowedTxn
response_fields.description: NumberAllowedTxn of virtual card will set to this field value. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:10

response_fields.name: ResponseID
response_fields.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking Allowable Values: 15

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
